title: The Storm
hook: No flash. It's right beside us.
question: Would you run in the lightning, or wait in the dark?
synopsis: The Hush is right behind the last car on the open heath. Then a storm comes, and it stops to eat every flash of lightning. Rook puts out the lights and moves only when the sky flashes.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: The heath lamps went dark. It's here!
A storm ahead! It's faster on the heath!
Look! It stops to eat the lightning!
Lights out. We go only when it flashes.
Flash, go! Dark, stop. Flash, go!
No flash... It's coming this way.
Come on, storm. One more flash...
Keep the fire hot! It's coming!
Stone Town! Lights ahead. Hold on!
The storm is gone. It will be back.
